decisions.reason: As a newly launched automation system in a German machinery niche, the combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot is likely still in its market-development phase and worth retaining.
Although it overlaps partly with the combined robot, the automatic de-shuttering robot likely serves customers needing a modular or lower-cost standalone solution.
The profile storage robot appears to complement the broader production automation offering, so a mature machinery firm would usually keep it available beyond its first year.
Like the standalone de-shuttering unit, the automatic shuttering robot likely remains useful for customers who do not want or cannot integrate the combined version.
